limitations.note: The patch left yellow and red combinational instead of registering them on the rising clock edge using the pre-edge balance, with asynchronous reset.
The rewrite changed recharge cycles to deduct a fee after adding money, whereas the original and correct code give recharge priority and skip the fee when set is high.
This check expected red to change immediately after boost changed without a clock edge, so the passing test endorsed the combinational behavior it needed to catch.
The test never started on two attempts: the shell wrapper was rejected for its cleanup command, then the retry used an unavailable Python executable before a third attempt ran it.
